name: dsh-narrator
description: 长思考进度旁白插件：模型长时间只思考不出声时，注入一段提示词让它自己用正文说清进展（不结束当前任务），并把这段原文显示在对话区左下角浮窗；附带以分钟为单位的图形设置卡。(Progress narrator for DeepSeek Harness: inject a reminder so the model narrates its own progress when silent too long, without ending the turn; mirrors that text in a lower-left overlay; ships a minutes-based settings card.)

scripts.test: node --test test/apply.test.js test/client-render.test.mjs test/latest-cap.test.mjs test/pure.test.js test/route-origin.test.mjs test/route.test.mjs test/switch.test.mjs
